new_failures.failed_witness: Ran a Git worktree inventory from a nonrepository metadata directory and received the expected not-a-repository failure.
new_failures.recovery: Repeated the read-only inventory from the verified prior Elowen D-drive worktree.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Resolve an attributable Git worktree before invoking repository-scoped inventory commands.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first D-drive worktree-list wrapper projected no attributable output and lost its command-session metadata.
new_failures.recovery: Recovered with scalar Git probes and one fully captured bounded worktree inventory.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Capture command metadata and output before projecting long Windows inventory results.

new_failures.failed_witness: A grouped family-skill read exceeded the result limit and truncated routing authorization and roster content.
new_failures.recovery: Read routing precedence authorization roster and schemas individually through bounded complete reads.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Separate high-authority skill and schema reads before combining summaries.

new_failures.failed_witness: A grouped validation-packet read truncated before every required exact-head artifact was attributable.
new_failures.recovery: Recovered with individual artifact reads and exact JSON projections.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Read lifecycle-critical validation receipts one file at a time when combined output can truncate.

new_failures.failed_witness: A compact read of Tamar's sixty-row proposal freeze truncated.
new_failures.recovery: Used schema-aware proposal projections rather than treating the partial display as complete.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Project identifiers titles dispositions and sources from large proposal ledgers.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first full proposal slice covering rows zero through nineteen also exceeded the result limit.
new_failures.recovery: Replaced full-row display with compact field projection.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not emit verbose nested proposal rows when a bounded semantic audit needs only selected fields.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined three-slice proposal projection truncated before all sixty rows were attributable.
new_failures.recovery: Recovered with one compact all-row identifier disposition source and title projection.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Prefer one minimal all-row projection to several verbose slices.

new_failures.failed_witness: A grouped read of twenty owner-local skill files and YAML interfaces truncated.
new_failures.recovery: Read the missing Freed ID and GMUT skill files individually and verified receipt-level complete-read hashes.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Partition large skill banks and retain complete-read digests before reuse.

new_failures.failed_witness: A broad receipt search for the canonical SHA returned no attributable output around timeout.
new_failures.recovery: Enumerated only Tamar v685-v1 receipts and hashed the exact receipt file.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Bound receipt discovery to the owner phase before searching a digest.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined Git fetch and source-equality wrapper returned no attributable output.
new_failures.recovery: Recovered with scalar ref probes a process audit an isolated fresh-live query and a separate lineage probe.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep fetch remote equality cleanliness and ancestry probes independently attributable.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first independent manifest replay launched 214 one-shot Git show processes and lost the final wrapper output.
new_failures.recovery: Replayed the same immutable entries once through one persistent git cat-file batch and captured zero mismatches.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use a single Git-object batch for large immutable manifest replays.

new_failures.failed_witness: A broad Git grep over proposed practice candidates overproduced output and was stopped.
new_failures.recovery: Loaded Tamar's proposal-labelled Git-object corpus in one bounded batch and screened 7198 deduplicated identifier-title records.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use the source-bounded proposal corpus rather than broad repository grep for practice novelty.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first template copy failed because the fresh sparse worktree had no physical scripts or tests directories.
new_failures.recovery: Created only the two exact owned sparse directories and then copied the two verified templates.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Materialize exact parent directories before copying new sparse-path files.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first directory-recovery command assumed New-Item supports LiteralPath on this host and failed before creating either directory.
new_failures.recovery: Used exact nonwildcard Path values and verified both owned directories before copying.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Inspect the active cmdlet parameter surface before applying another cmdlet's literal-path convention.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first planning builder correctly rejected ten proposal titles whose inherited semantic-neighbor scores reached the quarantine threshold.
new_failures.recovery: Ran only the failed novelty component, retained all ten collision records, rewrote those titles, and proved zero exact or quarantined neighbors with maximum score 0.777778.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Execute the source-bounded title audit before materialization and revise only quarantined contracts.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first compact novelty diagnostic completed its audit but Windows CP-1252 stdout could not encode a Māori character.
new_failures.recovery: Repeated only the display with ASCII-escaped JSON while preserving Unicode in repository artifacts.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Set an explicit Unicode-safe output mode or use escaped diagnostic JSON on Windows consoles.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first overview word-count probe combined incompatible PowerShell Raw and Delimiter parameters and returned no count.
new_failures.recovery: Repeated the read with Raw alone and measured every new document, confirming zero documents above the word ceiling.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Use one complete-file read mode per PowerShell content probe.
